passages.provision_quote: A social media company shall post terms of service for each social media platform owned or operated by the company in a manner reasonably designed to inform all users of the social media platform of the existence and contents of the terms of service.
passages.note: AB 587 mandates content-moderation transparency reporting (including a disinformation/misinformation category), not removal, labeling, voluntary standards, free-speech protection, or a ban on government involvement.

rows.reasoning: AB 587's operative clauses require platforms to post terms of service and file transparency reports on content-moderation categories (including disinformation/misinformation) with the Attorney General; this is a disclosure mandate along a dimension none of the five rungs (remove, label, voluntary standards, protect free speech, ban government involvement) orders, so it is adjacent and cannot establish a chair.
